name: Arcturus Defense Solutions RamJet CV-9 Armored Personnel Carrier
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions RamJet CV-9 Armored Personnel Carrier
description:
The RamJet CV-9 is Arcturus Defense Solutions' primary tactical ground vehicle platform, an eight-wheeled armored personnel carrier designed specifically for Meridian 88's degraded urban terrain — flooded streets, collapsed infrastructure corridors, chemically contaminated surface zones, and the contested vertical transition zones between city tiers. The CV-9's drivetrain is a hybrid configuration: primary propulsion comes from an Ouroboros Energy CascadeCell-fed electric drive system delivering torque to all eight independently suspended wheels, while a secondary Ouroboros-licensed plasma microreactor provides sustained power for the vehicle's active systems during extended operations where recharging is unavailable. The hull is fabricated from Arcturus-proprietary stratified ceramic-metal composite rated to defeat standard-issue corporate security munitions, with additional reactive panel slots for mission-specific armor upgrades.

The CV-9's defining operational feature is its Cinderblock AI-integrated terrain navigation system, which continuously constructs a three-dimensional passability map of the surrounding urban environment using a combination of ground-penetrating sonar, optical sensors, and real-time data pulled from Saltmarsh Telecom's sensor lattice. This allows the CV-9 to autonomously identify and navigate partially flooded underpasses, structurally compromised elevated roads, and debris-choked surface corridors that would stop conventional vehicles — a capability that Arcturus markets as 'Adaptive Passage Logic.' The crew compartment carries eight operators in addition to the driver and commander, with an integrated Helix Biosystems medical stabilization bay capable of keeping two critically wounded personnel in supported status during extraction operations.

The CV-9 is standard issue for Arcturus corporate security deployments, available for contract lease to Tier 1 corporate clients requiring armed logistics or personnel security, and sold outright to Meridian 88's official Civic Enforcement Directorate. Its presence in lower-tier districts, where it is overwhelmingly deployed for 'compliance operations,' has made it one of the most hated symbols of corporate authority in the city.

social_impact: The RamJet CV-9's presence in Meridian 88's lower districts has transformed the texture of daily life for Tier 3 and Tier 4 residents in ways that statistics fail to capture. The vehicle's near-impenetrability to available lower-tier weapons, combined with its ability to navigate terrain that previously served as a natural barrier against enforcement incursions, has eliminated spatial refuges that communities had relied on for decades. Arcturus leases CV-9 units to corporate clients with no use-of-force audit requirements, meaning the same vehicle might suppress a labor action in the morning and deliver a corporate executive through a flooded district in the afternoon. The vehicle's Cinderblock AI terrain maps are also shared back to Arcturus's central database, meaning every CV-9 deployment passively contributes to a growing intelligence picture of lower-city infrastructure that no community consented to provide.
story_hooks: A CV-9 unit contracted to a pharmaceutical client has gone dark in the sublevel districts — Arcturus wants it back before whatever is inside it is discovered by whoever disabled it

A Tier 4 community has somehow acquired a decommissioned CV-9 hull and is using it as fortified housing — Arcturus claims it contains proprietary Cinderblock AI systems that must be physically recovered

The Civic Enforcement Directorate's CV-9 fleet has begun making patrol routes that correlate suspiciously with Kelpline Logistics' preferred labor suppression operations — someone is sharing tasking data they shouldn't have
A player character discovers that the CV-9's terrain mapping system has been quietly documenting a sublevel tunnel network that connects to something Arcturus has classified at the highest level
